title: The Effect of Self-Regulated Learning on Students' Learning Independence in Entrepreneurship Education
reason: One-group pretest-posttest of a self-report learning-independence questionnaire (N-Gain .52) plus an LMS-use perception questionnaire; no platform-recorded activity measure is analysed.

extraction.n_quote: involving 72 students enrolled in entrepreneurship courses.
extraction.population: undergraduate entrepreneurship students, Universitas Syiah Kuala
extraction.lms_indicators: none (Wadhwani Ignite LMS used for delivery)
extraction.notes: Pre/post change on a self-report construct; not an achievement comparison, hence NOREL rather than E4.
